choreography_schema.contract: Each finisher is assembled from independently animated semantic pieces. The source material plate may texture pieces, but it must never move as one intact picture.

silent_battle_rhythm.formation: three unequal ribs forge rear-to-front from the same diagonal pressure groove
paths: rib_1 short forward sweep
rib_2 catches and nests over rib_1
rib_3 accelerates through both into one heavy crescent
silent_battle_rhythm.impact: largest rib nose flattens, three heat cracks travel backward, nested ribs shear metal chips only to the exit side
silent_battle_rhythm.residue: one cooling copper cut scar, three rotating forged chips, grounded ember powder

horizon_stream.formation: short horizontal segments stitch into one thick horizon before the counter-cut exists
paths: horizon extends left-to-right
air sheets pull toward the line
one foreground crescent returns right-to-left and diagonally through it
horizon_stream.impact: crossing point pinches instead of blooming, horizon separates into upper and lower sheets, prism slabs peel horizontally
horizon_stream.residue: straight gold afterline, two relaxing cloud sheets, drifting prism plates

sudden_rain_cadence.formation: three depth groups condense overhead with unequal length, pitch and spacing
paths: rear triplet falls
middle group follows after a beat gap
three hero blades cross the near plane and converge on one low zone
sudden_rain_cadence.impact: blade tips pierce before their water skins overturn into one broad low crown; hero tips chip without turning into ice
sudden_rain_cadence.residue: three half-dissolved embedded tips, deep blue puddle, heavy drops and ground-hugging vapor

falling_moon_arc.formation: one incomplete thick crescent grows from a gold cutting edge and filled moonstone plates overhead
paths: rear mist stretches downward
crescent falls steeply with scale parallax
foreground moon chips overtake the body after contact
falling_moon_arc.impact: underside compresses into a short contact edge, cracks climb the moon face and one lower corner is physically removed
falling_moon_arc.residue: half-crescent erodes to silver grit, cratered slabs tumble, one low elliptical ground pressure wave thins out

thousand_blade_kill.formation: one engraved hero feather splits into asymmetric front/middle/rear flocks, never a radial wheel
paths: small rear blades launch outward
hero blades bend at offscreen boundary joints
return batches curve back from distinct depths and increasing scale
thousand_blade_kill.impact: spines enter one compact slit first, barbs split into amplifying cutters, two return trajectories cross without a round burst
thousand_blade_kill.residue: unreturned feathers skim the boundary, two narrowing silver tracks, old-gold barb chips

still_mountain.formation: wide grounded base interlocks upward into an asymmetric cold peak
paths: base plates settle inward under gravity
middle strata compress once per stored hit
only front fault slabs hinge outward at release
still_mountain.impact: peak stays fixed while the base fault lifts a low fan of heavy plates; no circular shockwave
still_mountain.residue: plates fall by weight, jagged hot fault cools to iron, amber grit crawls along the ground

stone_ring_guard.formation: unequal blocks lock one at a time around a functional breach with real front/rear occlusion
paths: rear blocks seat first
foreground block depresses along the incoming vector
broken pieces leave through the breach then curve slightly toward the recorded attacker
stone_ring_guard.impact: most-hit block splits along bedding and its clamp straightens into a launch rail
stone_ring_guard.residue: intact blocks drop sequentially, tracked fragments leave short mineral dust, spent clamps remain on ground

tempered_bones.formation: spine locks first, paired ribs forge top-to-bottom, sternum closes the defensive cage
paths: each absorbed hit bends and tempers one rib
ribs release bottom-to-top and nest into five fingers
sternum and spine telescope forward as fist face and forearm
tempered_bones.impact: knuckle face dents and forge-cracks, throwing only metal armor slabs along the punch axis
tempered_bones.residue: fist unfolds into cooling ribs, quench scales rotate down, one dark-red heat streak remains

trackless_gale.formation: three offset air corridors occupy rear, middle and foreground depths with black center seams
paths: rear corridor crosses first
middle and foreground corridors intersect at different heights
each passed corridor closes from both sides in the same delayed order
trackless_gale.impact: membranes meet into thick cyan blades and unzip forward one lane at a time, never simultaneously
trackless_gale.residue: three refractive air seams rebound by depth, sourced leaves and dust lose lift and fall

enduring_arcane_breath.formation: opposed silk streams wrap a short double helix around a deliberately dark reserve chamber
paths: far nodes reverse along the helix
silks tighten in breathing pulses rather than constant spin
filled strands melt inward and leave one stable glass pearl
enduring_arcane_breath.impact: condensation seals the outer breath; inner gold reserve flips and exhales one shorter warm pulse only on reprise
enduring_arcane_breath.residue: small indigo pearl retains a visible gold seed, wet silk tails recoil and sparse star sand returns outward

inexhaustible_reservoir.formation: asymmetric mineral plates assemble low while two water tongues feed a deep center
paths: water level rises inside the basin
one thick column pushes upward and forks at its crest
excess folds outward and downward into one or two curved skins according to reserve
inexhaustible_reservoir.impact: incoming force dents the water skin and grows a sourced crown at that dent before elastic recovery
inexhaustible_reservoir.residue: shield drains in heavy beads back to the basin, gold edge darkens, thin wet patch remains

returning_counterguard.formation: unequal trapezoid panels key onto two ridges and lock around a narrow central seam
paths: slab inclines to receive each hit
one wedge rotates to each recorded source vector
wedges eject back-to-front along those same vectors
returning_counterguard.impact: wedge tips flatten and crumble into fist-sized stone while compressed amber force escapes as directional fans
returning_counterguard.residue: three parallel rubble furrows, cooling metal skins, one weathering guard stump

inferno_cremation.formation: burn stacks pool into unequal liquid masses that join as one S-shaped ground river
paths: river bends between burning targets with outside-bank inertia
current narrows and climbs into a pursuing blade
blade wraps the fallen target then collapses upward into a cremation column
inferno_cremation.impact: stored heat compresses inside the column and ejects a grounded lava fan with liquid, slag and smoke
inferno_cremation.residue: S-shaped black crust, slowly moving orange seams, porous slag coughing short smoke

frozen_burial.formation: side plates rise from the feet, shoulder plates clamp next and one pointed cap seals last
paths: frost ridge crawls to nearby targets
main coffin contracts under stored force
zigzag crack runs down the spine, rebounds upward, then transmits along the ground ridge
frozen_burial.impact: plates hinge outward in six-to-nine thick pieces; each linked coffin repeats dent, fracture and hinge in order
frozen_burial.residue: thick translucent slabs, embedded cobalt spine, zigzag frost groove, edge meltwater

thunder_prison_pierce.formation: irregular bases open at staggered depth and grow five unequal plasma columns around an open corridor
paths: arcs jump pillar-to-pillar and carve a groove at each contact
column cores drain through grooves toward one gold spear blank
spear accelerates diagonally through the open corridor
thunder_prison_pierce.impact: spear telescopes into a narrow cut, splitting the contact plane into a V while columns collapse behind it
thunder_prison_pierce.residue: long scorched trench, smoking bases, glassy charged shell plates and two final grounded jumps

orchid_corrosion.formation: poison streams braid into a bent stem; unequal fleshy petals open one by one around a weighted sac
paths: flower folds toward poisoned enemy and siphons inward
loaded stem whips upward and petals turn enemy faces outward
sac vents low toward enemies while two intact sepals recoil toward allies
orchid_corrosion.impact: sac splits along three veins, petals tear into heavy acid drops, sepals flatten into clean dew sheets
orchid_corrosion.residue: bubbling enemy puddle and collapsed violet flesh opposite two clear ally droplets; stem dehydrates black

sunbearing_dawn.formation: offset light slabs make a movable beam; two soft leaves form the first recipient cup
paths: beam seeks lowest health, narrows, then slides by a broken line to the next ally
overflow spills over each cup and is caught by leaves bottom-to-top
beam returns to first ally and lowers the seed into the shell
sunbearing_dawn.impact: external force cracks the leaf shell without exploding; seed sends a short sprout through that crack
sunbearing_dawn.residue: two or three leaf shadows per ally, one tangible seed and fresh sprout on the revival holder

returning_spring_spirits.formation: one large and two small faceless water bodies wrap around veined leaf spines
paths: small spirit cleanses feet in foreground
main spirit spirals once outside the body and hands off to next ally
three routes meet as an open bud at the final station
returning_spring_spirits.impact: mud beads are thrown down; bud drinks, swells and opens five leaves into a grounded healing wave that returns along the patrol path
returning_spring_spirits.residue: three sprouts pin drained mud beads, clear drops soak into route, gray cleanse shells crack to powder

shared_bloodline.formation: uneven roots grow from team positions and braid into a grounded trunk, with upper branches left deliberately open
paths: captured blood enters one root tip
visible liquid divides with wider flow toward low-health branches
on lethal force the thick mother branch swings from trunk to that specific ally
shared_bloodline.impact: mother branch flattens, bark splits along fiber and liquid is squeezed back into surviving branches; torn fibers pull the ally upright
shared_bloodline.residue: charred trunk segment, slow-pulsing channels, woodening severed branch and fork-shaped ground grooves

evergreen_court.formation: moss pads swell first, two asymmetric trunks fork above them and the sap source opens at the shared wood knot
paths: sap climbs visible grain and splits by ally health state
shield leaves fold down over low-health zones
blade leaves turn edge-on then snap along full-health attack vectors
evergreen_court.impact: shield leaf dishes into moss and transfers force outward; blade leaf flings one wide cutting sap sheet then visibly thins
evergreen_court.residue: used blade leaves fall first, wet moss and flattened shields remain, sap condenses into one warm-green amber seed

silent_feather_cadence.formation: three parents stage on separate depths with an unmistakable short-short-long length pattern
paths: rust feather makes first straight short cut
ivory feather follows higher after one short gap
gold feather waits above and descends on a longer third arc; each parent recoils and releases one smaller echo
silent_feather_cadence.impact: tips hook into the same plane, barbs break front-to-back and echoes flatten shafts; long shaft splits into two scissor halves
silent_feather_cadence.residue: three parallel short-short-long cuts, textured barb fragments, gold half-shaft embedded last

skyward_returning_feathers.formation: one massive feathered crescent occupies foreground; eight independent blades stage 3 front, 3 middle, 2 rear
paths: plow crescent sweeps enemies toward one tight point
eight blades launch outward in rear-middle-front order
after crossing their apex, joints fold and return front-middle-rear shaft-first
skyward_returning_feathers.impact: eight spines compress one slit in sequence; plow feather arrives last and splits into giant shears through the slit
skyward_returning_feathers.residue: eight embedded short shafts, curved plow furrow, narrowing vertical skylight and depth-sorted feather debris

guarding_reflection.formation: four slanted shields assemble as an open fortress, front pair overlapping rear corners
paths: each shield retreats half a thickness on its own incoming vector
crack scars retain four distinct directions
panels rotate their normals then flip to eject along recorded exits
guarding_reflection.impact: scar light pinches into wedges, mirror plates spring flat, strongest wedge shaves one foreground metal corner
guarding_reflection.residue: thin dark mirror chips, four dim shield faces and short cooling scratches along real exit paths

gale_reservoir.formation: three route segments occupy distinct heights and create five crystals only where physical paths cross
paths: rear, middle and foreground ridges advance in order
crystals collect far-to-near and collapse their route behind them
all three ridges reverse from their tails and braid upward
gale_reservoir.impact: last crystal enters the core, braided column sharpens and crest folds outward into one refractive guard sheet
gale_reservoir.residue: wet grooves, falling water beads, gold crystal grit and one drying cyan track

balanced_elements.formation: opposed material walls grow on separate planes and touch only along one dark vertical seam
paths: rear water wall overruns fire and creates one steam wedge
foreground fire rolls back and ejects physical drops
lightning descends the seam in three distinct steps, transforming each touched section
balanced_elements.impact: spine forks sideways; water breaks as large ice-water plates and fire compresses into molten sheets, twisting forward as one three-phase wedge
balanced_elements.residue: steaming wet crack, melting plates left, dark molten drops right and only two charge jumps

heavenly_wheel_sever.formation: three thick open fire blades form a rear rolling rim, six feather cutters interleave in middle depth, toothed hub advances from front
paths: fire rim rolls and cuts a path
feather cutters split into two depth rows then scissor back
hub catches up last while arcs connect adjacent physical teeth
heavenly_wheel_sever.impact: fire rim crushes into an ellipse, feathers close into six cuts and hub locks; three teeth shear off along the advance axis
heavenly_wheel_sever.residue: one molten track, six short silver cuts, three sparking teeth and smoke sourced only from the hot groove

frost_orchid_flame.formation: six unequal petals grow from frost veins and close around visible poison; orange blade forges below only after closure
paths: petals finish freezing rear-to-front
poison beads compress inward
fire blade travels bottom-to-top and fracture follows immediately behind it
frost_orchid_flame.impact: petals open and break sequentially into melting plates; toxin is squeezed downward while fire blade remains readable through the crown
frost_orchid_flame.residue: five-lobed corrosive puddle, cold-smoking melt plates, orange cut scar and poisoned water droplets

sunlit_spring_court.formation: left and right vines grow as an open pointed arch around a low basin; crown is supported by leaves rather than a full sun disk
paths: cleanse flakes sweep outward first
basin streams flow inward and rise through the heal zone
crown ascends the arch and sends three depth-staggered beams into the water
sunlit_spring_court.impact: water folds upward from the basin into one thin gold-green canopy and pins to the arch; gray flakes crack where they touch it
sunlit_spring_court.residue: gold dew on leaf tips, shallow water trace, attached shield beads and cleansed powder flowing offscreen

returning_shared_pulse.formation: three depth-separated tubes grow inward and braid into an open clasp, explicitly not a heart silhouette
paths: damage crystals arrive one route at a time
clasp tightens with each arrival while spirit core rotates only half an orbit
mercy seed opens the clasp and core exits along the single low-health guide
returning_shared_pulse.impact: red crystal melts instead of bursting; one narrow gold-jade pulse leaves in a selected direction while unused tubes recoil as open lobes
returning_shared_pulse.residue: red-to-gold tube skin, orange droplets on chosen route, short spirit tail and relaxed dark fibers

guarding_shared_pulse.formation: vertical spine drives into a ground groove, then two thick halves hinge outward with real near/far overlap
paths: enemy force dents halves inward without rearward drift
red charge moves inside embedded channels to the hinge
halves open forward as a wedge while back pressure squeezes one small pulse toward allies
guarding_shared_pulse.impact: forward wedge ejects impact chips and bronze shavings; rear pulse remains smaller and lower-energy; anchor gains a permanent dent
guarding_shared_pulse.residue: anchor groove, heavy bronze chips, dark red crystals and exactly two ivory drops on the ally route

gale_moon_arc.formation: track grows from a deliberate gap in three depth segments; markers pin in order and center remains dark
paths: rear, middle and foreground track segments light sequentially along tangents
moon blank turns half a rotation to expose thickness
finished blade launches from center through the gap
gale_moon_arc.impact: blade severs the track and peels both ends outward as ribbons; nearest marker loses one physical corner
gale_moon_arc.residue: two torn wind bands, three dim directional markers, flat moon chips and ground mist following tangent or blade vectors

breathing_thunder_echo.formation: one trunk grows into an irregular ground-root network; four physical markers hook onto separate junctions at distinct depths
paths: gold echo shots arrive along four different arcs and become markers
current travels trunk-to-branch toward one marker at a time
four vertical spears strike in marker order, then one lateral arc links only struck nodes
breathing_thunder_echo.impact: each marker flattens at contact and ejects needles upward; light pools remain local and no central explosion forms
breathing_thunder_echo.residue: scorched branching network, four melted markers, upward cyan needles and two or three dying violet arcs
